🎓 What is spec-driven development? This guide covers GitHub's Spec Kit, spec coding with AI, and how the AI SDLC replaces vibe coding.

In this spec-driven development guide, you'll see:

Why the vibe coding prompt loop burns time and tokens before you ever get what you wanted
The six steps of the SDLC and the one step vibe coding actually cares about
How planning moved earlier, from test-driven development to the spec that drives everything
The AI SDLC piece by piece, constitution, spec, plan, tasks, build, and two levels of testing
A hands-on look at Spec Kit from GitHub, inst

video.description:
The video based on our blog article explains how spec-driven development, combined with Claude Code, helps teams turn detailed requirements into structured, reliable software implementations. It outlines a workflow in which developers define specifications first, use AI to generate and refine code, and validate the results through testing and review. This approach can improve development speed, consistency, and collaboration while reducing ambiguity and rework.

video.title: Spec-Driven Development (SDD): Specifications as Primary Human Output
video.rationale: Covers: topic ✓ (5:09–7:47), CO2.LO2 ✓ (3:40–7:47) [from transcript] · Mirko Solutions Media · tier 4 · 7:47 · 88 views · captions
video.description:
As AI coding agents automate syntax writing, human software engineering is shifting from writing code by hand to architecting precise technical specifications. Without unambiguous specs, autonomous agents waste cycles, hallucinate dependencies, and drift off-target.

This is a comprehensive look at Spec-Driven Development (SDD): structuring specification artifacts, eliminating ambiguity for AI agents, building executable specs, and setting up automated test rails.

WHAT YOU GET OUT OF IT - The paradigm shift from manual coding to specification architecture - The 4 essential SDD artifacts: REQUIREMENTS.md, OpenAPI, AGENTS.md, and TESTS.md - How to draft unambiguous specs that eliminate agent

review.review: Good conceptual explanation of treat specifications as primary technical artifacts when using AI code generation. Suitable for setting context before diving into concrete frameworks.
issues: conceptual focus on AI paradigm shift rather than step-by-step syntax
